Buffini Social Suite (Referral Maker Social Suite) is Buffini & Company’s automated social media platform for real estate agents, powered by Back At You [1]. It syncs your MLS listings within minutes to create social posts and ads, gives you a library of curated local and branded content for your content calendar, and auto-posts across your social platforms [1]. Its Design Studio has hundreds of pre-made digital and print templates [1]. Social Suite comes with Buffini’s Referral Maker PRO, One2One Coaching and Leadership Coaching memberships, and Referral Maker PRO is $149 a month in the US [1][2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Is Buffini Social Suite a done-for-you service?

Buffini describes Social Suite as professional social media content and posting done for you [1]. Your MLS listings sync automatically to create posts and ads, and you plan your calendar from a library of curated local and branded content [1].
Can I buy Buffini Social Suite without a coaching membership?
Yes. Buffini Social Suite comes with Referral Maker PRO, and One2One Coaching adds two monthly coaching calls on top of PRO [1]. Referral Maker PRO is $149 a month in the US [2].
Where does Buffini Social Suite post?
Buffini says Social Suite auto-posts listings and content across your social channels and lets you schedule posts and ads [1][2].
How much does Buffini Social Suite cost?

Buffini Social Suite comes with Buffini memberships, starting with Referral Maker PRO [1]. Referral Maker PRO is $149 a month in the US, or $1,590 a year, and Referral Maker PRO Personalized is $179 a month [2].
